worldcombat.skill.charm.summary: Charm a small fan in front of you (about 90° total, point-blank): up to 3 foes you can see each lose 2 Attack stages, and a wall between bodies spares them. You may instead blow a kiss: a slow, straight-flying heart pellet that reaches farther, but only drops one stage on the first foe it hits; a friend or a block intercepts and shatters it.
worldcombat.skill.charm.use.0: Soften several physical threats crowding your front together
worldcombat.skill.charm.use.1: Blunt a cluster of attackers before they close in
worldcombat.skill.charm.use.2: Top up the drop with a kiss from a little farther
worldcombat.skill.charm.description.0: Each target accepted by the fan loses %1$s Attack stage(s) and carries the Smitten mark for %2$s; the drop is owned by the mark carrier, so when it ends or is milk-cured only this source is returned and the ladder is restored exactly. While marked, a partner will not use Charm-family moves on it again.
worldcombat.skill.charm.description.1: Charm range %1$s: the real front-fan radius when close, or how far the pellet flies for a blow kiss; beyond that cannot be reached.
worldcombat.skill.charm.description.2: Windup %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. The close fan only covers the front and up to 3 bodies, and walls between bodies block it; it cannot stop foes behind you.
worldcombat.skill.charm.kiss.off: Cuddle: spread a front fan that can soften up to 3 targets at once, 2 stages each and lasting longer.
worldcombat.skill.charm.kiss.on: Blown kiss: releases a slow, straight-flying heart pellet that reaches much farther, but removes only 1 stage on the first foe it hits, lingers shorter, and winds up and cools down slower; a friend or a block intercepts the pellet.
worldcombat.skill.charm.kiss.flight: The kiss flies at %1$s blocks/tick with a %2$s pellet; it is slow enough to sidestep and can be intercepted by a friend or a block.
worldcombat.skill.charm.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
When on, releases a slow, straight-flying heart pellet: much longer range, but only 1 Attack stage on the first foe it hits, shorter duration, and slower windup and cooldown; a friend or a block intercepts the pellet. Off spreads a front fan that softens up to 3 front targets at once, 2 stages each and lasting longer.
worldcombat.skill.charm.preference.ai.ma: The companion only considers charm while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts sooner.
worldcombat.skill.charm.preference.ai.op: Countering charms only while the enemy attacks the companion or its owner, or right after a hit; Anytime charms at any threat.
worldcombat.skill.charm.preference.ai.pr: When on, a foe whose Attack clearly beats its Special Attack is prioritized; off treats every threat alike.
worldcombat.skill.charm.preference.ai.le: When on, the companion may leave its post to charm under a Hold order.
